item.title: Day 2 of jury selection continues in Aniah Blanchard murder case
item.description: TUSKEGEE, Ala. (WRBL) — Jury selection continues in the capital murder trial involving Aniah Blanchard, who was kidnapped from an Auburn gas station and found dead in the woods nearly seven years ago. Roughly 450 potential jurors have been called to the Tuskegee Municipal Complex this week as the long-delayed case finally moves toward trial. [...]

item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) — The Birmingham City Council has approved an ordinance temporarily suspending consideration of new hyperscale data center applications within city limits. item.title: Georgia upsets No. 16 Alabama 98-88
item.description: ATHENS, Ga. (WIAT) -- Alabama basketball had its eight-game winning streak snapped Tuesday night against Georgia. The Bulldogs defeated the No. 16 Crimson Tide 98-88. Sophomore Kanon Catchings finished with a career-high 32 points, shooting 7-of-13 from 3-point range to lead Georgia to the upset.
